subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Kindred Schemes
email_body:
Hi R.K.,

Kindred Schemes, your debut released in February, a Regency romance with a love triangle between the Duke of Ashford and the Marquess of Rochester, caught my attention, and so did the way you bring your engineering background to your writing.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Kindred Schemes is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, from concept to finished files, with the glamour and mystery of the story front and center. This is purely an optional add-on, and the Spotlight stands on its own either way.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Kindred Schemes best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
